name: Coronar
description: The planet Coronar was the site of an Imperial Intelligence base during the Galactic Civil War. After the Empire's destruction of the Alliance to Restore the Republic base on Dankayo, several datapacks were recovered from the ruins. They were consigned for analysis on Coronar aboard the Imperial Armored Transport Elusive, but the shipment was intercepted by Alliance agents, and Elusive was destroyed.
